# Itzam.ai

> Itzam.AI is a Mexican AI agency that automates sales operations with AI — in weeks, not months. We help commercial teams in Mexico and LatAm go from a 2-week diagnostic to deployed AI systems. Headquartered in Mexico City, serving Latin America and the United States in English and Spanish.

## What we do

Itzam.ai turns AI from a slide deck into something a sales team uses on Monday morning. Every engagement ends with a working system and a tangible deliverable.

- AI Opportunity Assessment — a 2-week diagnostic that identifies, prioritizes, and quantifies AI opportunities across your commercial operation, with realistic timelines and costs.
- Sales Playbook Generator — an AI-built sales-enablement kit (pitch, objections, scripts, decks, discovery, onboarding) customized to your industries and sales cycle.
- Customer Support Engine — an AI agent on WhatsApp Business and web chat, trained on your knowledge, with configurable escalation and real handoff to humans.
- Itzam Business Brain Lab — a branded AI assistant trained on your internal knowledge, available 24/7 to your team (Internal Brain) or your channel partners (Channel Brain).

## Who we work with

- Commercial and sales teams in Mexico and Spanish-speaking LatAm (Mexico first, LatAm second, US-LatAm corridors third).
- Mid-market and enterprise companies that want AI deployed, not pilots.
- CEOs, CCOs, CROs, COOs, Sales Directors, and Heads of Operations / Customer Experience.

## How we work

- Founders do the work — they design, build, and deliver everything we sell.
- Pragmatism over theater — the simplest stack that solves the problem. No model worship.
- Weeks, not months. The AI Opportunity Assessment lands in 2 weeks; engagements compound from there.
- Tangible deliverables, every time. Every engagement ends with something working — and a number to point at.
- Bilingual (English / Spanish). LatAm-native. Enterprise-fluent across North America.

## Founders

- Carlos Bueso — CEO & Co-founder. 25+ years scaling AI-native, cloud, and data platforms across LatAm and North America. Built and led teams that modernize GTM models and scale partner ecosystems. Experience at Cisco, Rackspace, Microsoft, and Experis.
- Carlos Adrián Bueso — CTO & Co-founder. Software engineer and computer scientist focused on AI-driven systems. Co-founder & CTO of Alquimia Studio. Previously quantitative software engineer at AllianceBernstein. Currently developing Voxcentra, an AI-native generative-cinema project.

## Identity

- Brand: Itzam (named after Itzamná, the Mayan god of knowledge).
- Tagline: Intelligence, deployed.
- Languages: English, Spanish.
- Locales: en-US, es-MX.
